Definition: from G1537 and G3736; to dig out, i.e. (by extension) to extract (an eye), remove (roofing):--break up, pluck out.
BiblicalUsage: exorýssō is a plain word for break up, pluck out. In Galatians 4:15, the text says "ye would have plucked out your own eyes."
TheologicalSignificance: This one, exorýssō, I take at face value: break up, pluck out.
